feedback.goal: Close audit P0-1 (oracle leakage): the e2e agent must never see goal_state — split agent-visible task inputs from the evaluator-only oracle, de-oracle the skill, and add regression tests.

acceptance_criteria.statement: agentVisibleTask exposes only task_id/domain/instruction/initial_state; the driver writes the agent-visible projection and the prompt references it, never the oracle-bearing task file.
The workflow skill's output-convention wording no longer references goal_state; verification is grounded in the written policy.
Regression tests assert the prompt and skill stay oracle-free; the full gate passes.

outcome.summary: Oracle split landed: the grader keeps goal_state on the evaluator-only side while the agent sees only the agent-visible projection and the written policy; regression-guarded by tests/e2e-oracle.test.ts.

what_worked: A shared prompt module (e2e-prompt.ts) makes the prompt contract testable instead of living inside the run script.
The skill's exact-shape rule was rewritten as a domain output convention, preserving the task-005 fix without oracle wording.
what_failed: An unrelated time-bomb fixture surfaced during the gate (propose test decision expired 2026-08-30T18:00Z); its expiry was extended to 2027.

calls.name: oracle-split
calls.purpose: Add agentVisibleTask, rewrite the e2e driver and prompt module, and de-oracle the skill.

calls.name: pnpm-check
calls.purpose: Run the full repository verification gate.

evidence.summary: Three guards: agent-visible projection excludes goal_state/policy_ref; the prompt references only the projection plus the written policy; the skill contains no goal_state.
Typecheck, build, 141 tests, capsule checks, policy check, v0 suite, and benchmark suite all passed on improvements/audit-borrows.

notes: Benchmark-internal change only; no model calls, external transfers, or approvals.
